_about: 351 Watch Rhode Island: all 39 municipalities via the RI Secretary of State Open Meetings portal (https://opengov.sos.ri.gov), where every public body must file notices and agendas 48 hours ahead (R.I. Gen. Laws 42-46-6). platform 'ri_sos' -> watch351/adapters/ri_sos.py. Each listing is one portal public body (entity_id); board names are the portal's minus the town. Built by `python3 experiments/ri_sos_build.py discover`.
evidence_rule: a portal body is listed if it has a non-cancelled meeting filed in the last 730 days or upcoming (RI bodies must file every meeting on the portal, so a quiet body is still covered when it next meets); n_recent counts meetings within 120 days either side
